stemMd: A draft EU law has been proposed by the Commission. Under the ordinary legislative procedure, which two bodies usually adopt it together?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The ECB and the Court of Auditors

options.label: C
options.textMd: The European Parliament and the Council of the European Union

options.label: D
options.textMd: The Court of Justice and the ECB

options.label: E
options.textMd: The Council of Europe and NATO

explanationMd: Parliament and the Council of the EU act as co-legislators under the ordinary procedure. The Commission's proposal begins the process but does not alone complete adoption. This tests the division of legislative functions.

distractorRationale.a: Neither pair forms the ordinary legislative co-legislators.
distractorRationale.b: Local authorities do not adopt EU legislation this way.
distractorRationale.e: Both are separate from the EU legislative process.
distractorRationale.d: Judicial and monetary institutions are not the ordinary co-legislators.
